purpose: Outcome-blind assignment of each APBP candidate breeding site to one uniquely resolvable SCAR ADD land-polygon anchor before any island/mainland or demographic analysis.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: Only site coordinates, species identity, region labels, CCAMLR unit and temporal-coverage eligibility may be used. Population trend direction, abundance change and endpoint outcomes remain unopened.

scar_add.dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

why_v4.v3_result: Service-native v3 matched 94/122 sites exactly and 120/122 within 500 m, but 50/122 sites had more than one raw land FID within 500 m.
why_v4.interpretation: A fixed-radius neighborhood can include the focal land polygon plus nearby islets or continental land; multiple raw FIDs therefore do not imply biological ambiguity.
why_v4.v4_change_only: Resolve each site by exact containment first; only exact misses are assigned to the unique FID encountered at the smallest service-native distance. Raw FIDs remain geometric anchors, not islands.

assignment_rule.step_1_exact: Query the WGS84 point with distance 0. If exactly one land FID intersects, assign it with assignment_distance_m=0.
assignment_rule.step_2_exact_multiple: If more than one land FID intersects at distance 0, mark the site ambiguous and do not choose among them.
assignment_rule.step_3_nearest_search: If no exact land FID intersects, verify at least one land FID exists within 5000 m, then binary-search the smallest integer distance in meters at which any land FID is returned.
assignment_rule.step_4_nearest_unique: At that minimum distance, assign only if exactly one land FID is returned; if multiple FIDs first appear at the same minimum distance, mark the site ambiguous.

acceptance_rule.definition_unresolved: no land FID within 5000 m OR more than one FID at exact intersection OR more than one FID at the minimum positive assignment distance
acceptance_rule.rule: Gate 1A v4 passes only if at least 95% of 122 candidate sites receive one unique land-FID anchor and no more than 5% remain unresolved.

boundary: An assigned FID is a SCAR geometric anchor, not yet a biological island.
No raw-FID area is interpreted as island area in Gate 1A.
Island/mainland classification and landmass aggregation are deferred to Gate 1B.
No demographic response is joined before Gate 1B rules are frozen.

next_gate_only_if_passed.name: Gate 1B raw-FID to landmass aggregation and minimal island-architecture traits
planned_traits: landmass identifier derived from connected/adjacent SCAR land geometry
distance to continental land for offshore islands
